name: GEdit-Bench
description: GEdit-Bench is a novel benchmark for image editing evaluation rooted in real-world user instructions, designed to assess the performance of image editing models in fulfilling diverse user-driven editing requirements.
reputation: A very recent benchmark for real-world image editing instruction following, with limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Benchmark is based on real-world user instructions and used to evaluate image editing models including open-source and proprietary ones.
